name: Gloaming
author: Erin Carter
description: Blue hour deepening to night across the whole frame: a warm-to-indigo horizon glow fades and cools as fixed stars blink on one by one, until full night holds and a faint dawn tint rises to rinse them away. One imperceptibly slow closed colour cycle; nothing translates, all motion is luminance and hue.

params.label: Cycle period
params.effect: Seconds per full dusk-to-dusk cycle; short values make the day breathe visibly, long values make the change subliminal.

params.label: Glow height
params.effect: Vertical extent of the horizon glow band in CSS pixels, from a thin distant rim of light to a tall luminous haze rising off the hills.

params.label: Glow intensity
params.effect: Brightness of the warm horizon glow and the ridge rim; 0 leaves a bare dark horizon, 2 a vivid dusk afterglow.

params.label: Star density
params.effect: How many stars blink on as night deepens, denser toward the horizon so the field thickens above the hills.
